name: Pokémon Black 2 & White 2
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. All teams are the Normal Mode teams (not Easy or Challenge Mode). The Elite Four can be battled in any order; they are listed in the conventional Shauntal, Grimsley, Caitlin, Marshal sequence. Gym order differs from Black/White: Drayden is the 7th gym and Marlon (Humilau City) is the 8th.
